focus: A verified staging update reduces interruption pressure: first-time consent and functional onboarding get priority, while returning visitors receive at most one automatic prompt per tab with repeat-prompt cooldowns. Production has not yet received this update because the existing identity verification gate is still pending.
nextStep: Finish the remaining sign-in verification before publishing the full update; meanwhile, measure interruption pressure only in anonymous groups, never as individual browsing histories.

decisions.note: Expose a small deterministic mobile cohort and re-check close mix.
Refresh RUM UX ingestion before treating zero or low conversion as visitor behaviour.
Flip strict only after field p75 is sufficient and healthy.
Route top themes into feedback decision board lanes.
